places.name_ja: 広島城 天守閣／三の丸
places.description_ja: 天守閣は2026年3月で公開終了予定。見納めムードの今こそ訪れておきたいスポットです。9月下旬からは夜間ライトアップや武将隊イベントなども予定され、写真映えもばっちり。三の丸エリアは2025年春にリニューアルし、歴史展示や文化体験、カフェやショップが加わって立ち寄りやすい城下町に進化。国際会議場から歩いて行ける距離感もうれしいところ。
places.name_en: Hiroshima Castle Main Tower / Third Bailey
places.description_en: The castle tower is scheduled to close in March 2026. Now is the perfect time to visit as it's nearing its final run. From late September, there will be nighttime illuminations and samurai troop events, making it a great spot for photos. The San-no-maru area will be renovated in the spring of 2025, evolving into a more accessible castle town with historical exhibits, cultural experiences, cafes, and shops. It's also conveniently located within walking distance of the International Conference Center.

places.name_ja: ひろしまスタジアムパーク
places.description_ja: 2024年に誕生したまちなかスタジアム。サッカー観戦はもちろん、スタジアム周辺にはショップやカフェ、子ども連れにうれしいエリアも整備され、イベントがない日でも楽しめます。広々とした空間でリフレッシュしたいときにおすすめ。
places.description_en: This city-center stadium opened in 2024. Besides watching soccer matches, the surrounding area features shops, cafes, and areas perfect for families with children, making it enjoyable even on days without events. It's highly recommended for those who want to refresh themselves in a spacious environment.

places.description_ja: 2025年春にグランドオープンした新しい広島駅。約180店舗のショップやレストラン、映画館までそろい、到着した瞬間から遊べる街ナカ拠点に。新幹線で到着後すぐにカフェで作業したり、帰りの前にショッピングしたり、時間があれば映画や屋上広場「Soramoa」でのんびり過ごすのもおすすめ。移動中の通過点ではなく、滞在そのものを楽しめる拠点になっています。
places.description_en: The new Hiroshima Station, which had its grand opening in the spring of 2025, boasts approximately 180 shops, restaurants, and even a movie theater, making it a city hub where you can start having fun the moment you arrive. You can work at a cafe as soon as you arrive by Shinkansen, shop before heading home, or if you have time, relax at a movie theater or the rooftop plaza "Soramoa." It's not just a transit point, but a base where you can enjoy your stay itself.

places.description_ja: 縮景園に隣接する美術館では、広島や平和をテーマにした作品も並ぶ所蔵品展を開催中（～10月5日）。アートを楽しんだあとは庭園をのんびり散歩するのも◎。展示室で静かに作品を眺めて、緑の中で深呼吸。都会の中のオアシスのようなスポットです。
places.description_en: The art museum adjacent to Shukkei-en Garden is currently holding an exhibition of its collection, including works themed on Hiroshima and peace (until October 5th). After enjoying the art, a leisurely stroll through the garden is highly recommended. Quietly contemplate the artwork in the exhibition rooms and take a deep breath amidst the greenery. It's like an oasis in the city.

places.name_ja: ひろしまゲートパーク
places.description_ja: 旧市民球場跡地に2023年オープンした、芝生広場と商業施設が一体になった大型複合施設です。園内には「Pride of Hiroshima」という常設展示があり、広島の復興や未来への挑戦を紹介しています。原爆ドームや平和記念公園から近く、国際会議場からのアクセスも良好です。
places.description_en: Opened in 2023 on the site of the former Hiroshima Municipal Baseball Stadium, this large-scale complex combines a lawn area with commercial facilities. The park features a permanent exhibition called "Pride of Hiroshima," showcasing Hiroshima's recovery and its challenges for the future. It's conveniently located near the Atomic Bomb Dome and Peace Memorial Park, and easily accessible from the International Conference Center.

places.description_ja:
2019年にリニューアルされ、被爆者の遺品や証言を通して被爆の実相をより深く知ることができる展示に。写真や年表だけでなく実物資料が多く、当時の暮らしや人々の思いがリアルに伝わってきます。Webで事前にチケットを取れば、混雑時でもスムーズに入場できます。
なお、PyCon JP 2025参加者の皆様には、9月26日～9月30日の期間中、特別に入館料免除の措置が適用されます。参加者ネームタグを入口で提示していただければ、チケット購入の列に並ぶことなく、直接2階へのエスカレーターにお進みいただけます。期間中は何度でも入館可能ですが、7：30～8：30と17：30～18：30の時間帯は事前予約者優先となりますので、この時間を避けてのご来館をお勧めいたします。
places.description_en:
Renovated in 2019, the museum now offers a deeper understanding of the reality of the atomic bombing through the relics and testimonies of survivors. Featuring numerous actual artifacts in addition to photographs and timelines, it realistically conveys the lives and feelings of the people at that time. Pre-booking tickets online allows for smoother entry even during peak hours.

Furthermore, PyCon JP 2025 participants will receive a special exemption from admission fees from September 26th to September 30th. By presenting your participant name tag at the entrance, you can proceed directly to the escalator to the second floor without having to wait in line to purchase tickets. You can enter the museum multiple times during this period, however, priority will be given to those with prior reservations between 7:30-8:30 and 17:30-18:30, so we recommend avoiding these times.

places.description_ja: 2025年3月オープン。県産木材や牡蠣殻を活用したサステナブルなデザインが特徴で、芝生広場やテラス席もあり、リラックスしながら過ごせます。広島城や平和記念公園の散策途中に立ち寄るのにぴったりな、ちょっと新しい休憩スポット。
places.name_en: Shop & Cafe in front of the Prefectural Office
places.description_en: Opened in March 2025, this facility features a sustainable design utilizing locally sourced timber and oyster shells. With a lawn area and terrace seating, it offers a relaxing atmosphere. It's a perfect, slightly unconventional rest stop during a stroll around Hiroshima Castle or Peace Memorial Park.
